description: This file defines classes and functions for managing context and conversation history in the AWS Nova Sonic LLM service, including deprecated patterns and new context handling mechanisms, with focus on message processing, context aggregation, and role management.

classes.name: Role
classes.description: Enum representing roles in AWS Nova Sonic conversations: SYSTEM, USER, ASSISTANT, TOOL.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicConversationHistoryMessage
classes.description: Represents a single message in AWS Nova Sonic conversation history, with role and text.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicConversationHistory
classes.description: Holds the complete conversation history including system instruction and messages.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicLLMContext
classes.description: A specialized context class for AWS Nova Sonic, extending OpenAILLMContext with message handling, history management, and deprecation notices.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicMessagesUpdateFrame
classes.description: Frame containing updated AWS Nova Sonic context.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicUserContextAggregator
classes.description: Aggregator for user messages, extending OpenAIUserContextAggregator, with custom frame processing.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicAssistantContextAggregator
classes.description: Aggregator for assistant messages, extending OpenAIAssistantContextAggregator, with custom frame processing.

classes.name: AWSNovaSonicContextAggregatorPair
classes.description: Pair of user and assistant context aggregators for AWS Nova Sonic, marked as deprecated.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes AWSNovaSonicLLMContext with optional messages and tools, calling parent constructor.

methods.name: __setup_local
methods.description: Sets up local variables for assistant text, user text, and system instruction.

methods.name: upgrade_to_nova_sonic
methods.description: Static method to upgrade an OpenAILLMContext to AWSNovaSonicLLMContext with a system instruction.

methods.name: get_messages_for_initializing_history
methods.description: Generates conversation history for initializing AWS Nova Sonic, extracting system instruction and messages.

methods.name: get_messages_for_persistent_storage
methods.description: Returns messages formatted for persistent storage, including system instruction if present.

methods.name: from_standard_message
methods.description: Converts a standard message dict to AWS Nova Sonic message format.

methods.name: buffer_user_text
methods.description: Buffers user text for later flushing.

methods.name: flush_aggregated_user_text
methods.description: Flushes buffered user text into a message and adds it to the context.

methods.name: buffer_assistant_text
methods.description: Buffers assistant text for later flushing.

methods.name: flush_aggregated_assistant_text
methods.description: Flushes buffered assistant text into a message and adds it to the context.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes a frame with special handling for Nova Sonic-specific frames, with deprecation warnings.

methods.name: handle_function_call_result
methods.description: Handles function call result frames, pushing a special frame for server-side context update.
